user.title: Add an AquaIllumination light
user.description: Add one fixture at a time — run this again for each of your Hydra 52 HDs. Enter that fixture's local IP address (find it in the myAI app under the light's Wi-Fi settings), a short name to identify it, and the password you set for it (the same one its own web page at http://<ip>/login.html asks for).

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to a light at that address. Check the IP address and make sure it's powered on and on the same network as Home Assistant.
error.invalid_auth: That password was rejected by the light. Double check it against the one that unlocks http://<ip>/login.html for this fixture.
